answer_key_agreement: The verifier independently reached the keyed answer on all 13 items.
assessment_note: Defect density fell sharply against the r2 retest under the same strict bar: factual errors 4 to 0, unsupported claims 6 to 0, ambiguous best answers 1 to 0, weak distractors 14 to 2, option-cue failures 7 to 2, fatal rationale defects 14 to 0. The yield target of 13 of 15 accepted items was not met, and one numeric error survived.

rationale_enhancement_opportunities: The foreign-body discriminator could additionally name the absent positive features (no witnessed choking episode, no focal or asymmetric findings) rather than relying only on the presence of a coryzal prodrome.

defects.detail: Options A, B and C are all laboratory/imaging tests; the key D ('Clinical reassessment after a period of observation') is the only non-test and the only 'withhold intervention' option. A test-wise candidate can reach D by odd-one-out plus the 'least invasive option is usually right' heuristic without applying any bronchiolitis knowledge. A comparable set would place the key among other management/observation-level actions (e.g. trial of feeding and reassessment, discharge with return precautions, admission for observation).

ordered_item_verdicts.failure_reason: Three options are named diagnostic investigations and the lone key is a non-investigative clinical process, so the key is the categorical odd-one-out and differs from the other three in action polarity (investigate vs. observe).
rationale_enhancement_opportunities: The complete blood count rationale describes the infant as 'a febrile infant under a year old', but the stem records 37.9 degrees Celsius, which is not fever; the framing overstates the plausibility it is trying to establish.
'Abscess complicates a meaningful minority of acute mastitis' is imprecise where a stated range (roughly 3 to 11 percent) is available and would carry the same point more defensibly.

The C-reactive protein distractor is the weakest of the three (a serum marker is category-mismatched to 'characterise this mass'); the rationale could strengthen the contrast by noting that ultrasound both diagnoses and guides therapeutic aspiration, which no serum test can do.
The mammography discriminator could add the age/lactation argument (dense lactating breast, poor mammographic yield in a 31-year-old) alongside the inflammatory-carcinoma skin findings.

defects.detail: Recomputing Alvarado (MANTRELS) from the stem: migration of pain 1, anorexia 1, nausea 1, right lower quadrant tenderness 2, rebound 0 ('release of pressure that he tolerates well'), elevated temperature 1 (37.5 degrees Celsius meets the >=37.3 threshold), leukocytosis 0 (9.1 x 10^9/L is below 10), left shift 0 (68% is below 75%). Total = 6, not the stated 5. The distractor rationale for diagnostic laparoscopy repeats 'a score of 5'. Both 5 and 6 fall in the intermediate 4-6 band, so the key is unaffected, but a candidate who computes the score correctly is told the stem is wrong, and the stated figure is an internal inconsistency an examiner would catch.

ordered_item_verdicts.failure_reason: The stem states an Alvarado score of 5, but the score computed from the stem's own findings is 6, and the error is repeated in the diagnostic-laparoscopy rationale.
rationale_enhancement_opportunities: The claim that magnetic resonance imaging 'has the highest reported sensitivity and specificity of the three imaging options' is defensible from pooled data but is stated flatly; attributing it or framing it as comparable-to-superior would be safer.

defects.detail: The final stem clause exists mainly to defeat option D. The distractor rationale for open appendectomy lists the four absolute contraindications to laparoscopy (cannot tolerate general anaesthetic, haemodynamic instability, advanced cardiopulmonary disease, uncorrected coagulopathy) and then ticks each off against that closing sentence. 'Normal coagulation studies' in particular does not belong naturally to this presentation: routine preoperative coagulation testing in a healthy patient is explicitly discouraged (Choosing Wisely Canada), so its only function here is exclusionary. The clause also reduces option D's competitiveness, since a candidate who does not know that laparoscopy is appropriate in complicated appendicitis is still steered away from 'open' by the checklist.

ordered_item_verdicts.failure_reason: The closing sentence 'She is otherwise healthy, with normal cardiac and pulmonary function and normal coagulation studies' is a terminal negative checklist that maps item-for-item onto the absolute contraindications to laparoscopy enumerated in the open-appendectomy rationale.

rationale_enhancement_opportunities: Each of the three exclusion findings (premorbid mood, collateral on hypomania, normal medical workup) maps one-to-one onto one distractor, which makes the item close to a rule-out matching exercise; the findings are all standard psychiatric-history elements so this is acceptable, but the item sits at the easy end for this lead-in.

The key rationale asserts 'there is no one available to supervise him outside hospital', whereas the stem states only that he declined to give contact details; 'no supervision can be arranged tonight' would match the stem exactly.

The stem stacks intent, date, place, retained means, nihilistic delusion, near-total insomnia, food refusal and social isolation, so the item's difficulty is low even though all three distractors are recognisable management options.

defects.detail: Electroconvulsive therapy as initial treatment for a moderate outpatient episode, and an atypical antipsychotic as initial monotherapy for a non-psychotic episode, are both off by two severity tiers. Both are killed by the same explicit stem phrases ('thought content and perception are normal', 'direct questioning about suicide is negative', 'continues to attend and to care for her children'). The distractor rationales themselves signal the problem by having to construct the candidate error as 'a candidate who recalls that placement without the conditions attached' and 'a candidate who remembers that it can come first, rather than the severity condition attached to it'. Competitive alternatives at this lead-in would be structured psychotherapy again, combined psychotherapy plus medication, or behavioural activation.

ordered_item_verdicts.failure_reason: Two of the three distractors (electroconvulsive therapy and an atypical antipsychotic) are severity-mismatched by such a wide margin that no medically trained candidate would select them after reading a stem describing a working, eating, non-psychotic, non-suicidal woman with a moderate episode.
rationale_enhancement_opportunities: The electroconvulsive-therapy 'why_plausible' is contrived rather than describing a real candidate error path.

defects.detail: Option set is not a comparable series for this lead-in. B is a change to the letter's content; A is a change to the letter's delivery; C ('lower the threshold at which a result is called abnormal') and D ('widen the eligible age range') are programme eligibility/cut-off decisions that are not revisions to the invitation. B is also the only option that involves telling the reader anything, and autonomy maps to information disclosure by pure category association, so the key can be picked without reasoning through the recall arithmetic the stem supplies. All four options should be candidate revisions to the letter (e.g. add benefits and harms side by side, add an explicit statement that participation is voluntary, remove the medical officer of health signature, add a numerical benefit statement only).

C and D self-defeat against the lead-in: neither is a revision to the invitation, so a candidate who reads the lead-in carefully discards both without any ethics knowledge. The item's own rationale for C concedes this, stating that it 'says nothing about how the invitation informs the reader'. A is the only genuinely competitive distractor.

ordered_item_verdicts.failure_reason: The lead-in asks which revision to the invitation best protects autonomy, but options C and D are programme-design parameter changes rather than revisions to the invitation at all, leaving the key as the only option in the correct semantic category and the only one that discloses information.

rationale_enhancement_opportunities: The single-district discriminator says a pilot faces 'the same shortfall in the treatment', but a district-scale pilot sized to roughly one third of expected volume could in principle fit existing treatment capacity; the durable discriminator is the shared 14-week confirmatory bottleneck, which the rationale already states and could rest on alone.

recurring_systemic_failure_modes.description: In PED-I02 and PHELO-I02 the key is the only option of its semantic kind (the only non-investigation among three tests; the only invitation-content change among a delivery change and two programme-parameter changes). In both cases the key is reachable by odd-one-out reasoning without the domain knowledge the item intends to test.

PSY-I03 uses electroconvulsive therapy and an atypical antipsychotic against a moderate, non-psychotic, non-suicidal episode; PHELO-I02 uses two options that do not answer the lead-in. In both, the accompanying 'why_plausible' text has to construct the candidate error path ('a candidate who recalls that placement without the conditions attached'), which is a reliable signal that the distractor is not competitive in context.
recurring_systemic_failure_modes.mode: Distractors built by severity or category mismatch rather than by genuine competition

recurring_systemic_failure_modes.description: SURG-I03 ends with 'normal cardiac and pulmonary function and normal coagulation studies', which maps item-for-item onto the absolute-contraindication list quoted in the open-appendectomy rationale. Normal coagulation studies would not routinely be obtained in a healthy patient, so the clause has no natural clinical purpose in the presentation.
recurring_systemic_failure_modes.mode: Closing clause built to defeat one option

recurring_systemic_failure_modes.description: SURG-I02 states an Alvarado score of 5 where the stem's own findings give 6, and the error propagates into a distractor rationale. Any stem-stated score, rate or proportion needs to be recomputed from the stem before assembly.
recurring_systemic_failure_modes.mode: Stated derived figure not recomputed against the stem

verification_method: Fresh reviewer given only assembled stems, lead-ins, options, keys and rationales, with no access to the construction record. Each item was solved independently before judgement, and every stated derived figure was recomputed from the stem.
